title: Apple Account 2FA on this Mac: allow the alert, read the code window
symptom: A web or app sign-in asks for a code sent to this Mac; the notification 'Apple Account signed in' must be allowed and the code read from a system window
cause: macOS shows the request as a Notification Center alert with hidden actions (Allow, Don't Allow) and the code in a floating FollowUpUI window (CoreFollowUp, layer 25) that also holds keyboard focus
fix: Ask the user first: Allow approves a sign-in to their Apple Account. Only for the sign-in this session just started
launch_cli.py desktop wait --window overlay --text "Apple" --timeout 60, then click --ref <ref> --action "<Allow name from named_actions>" --confirm-mutating after the user agrees
launch_cli.py desktop tree --window overlay  # the code is a static text with spaces, e.g. '4 1 9   2 0 1'; remove the spaces
Press the code window's Done button with --confirm-mutating so it returns keyboard focus, then type the code with desktop type --ref <first box> --text <code> --keys or web type
A wrong or partial entry invalidates the code; resend once from the page and do not retry in a loop (the account can be locked)
